name: @unimem/desktop
//productName: Electron derives app.getName() - and therefore the userData directory - from this, falling back to `name`. Without it the app would store data under 'Application Support/@unimem/desktop'.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,shell -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @unimem/web dev" "pnpm run dev:shell"
scripts.dev:shell: wait-on tcp:3000 && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:preload
scripts.package: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:renderer && electron-builder
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
